head: a66f4b770364ef0b7c12b9bcfba8f5875cf026ac
claim: Draft pull requests run no CI jobs (all 8 skipped, none on a runner), and a ready PR's own run still passes all 8 jobs

steps.start: A repository whose CI ran 7-8 jobs on every draft push and 8 jobs again on every push to main
steps: Open PR 778 ready: CI runs and all 8 jobs pass (pr778-run-jobs.txt)
Open a throwaway draft PR from the same commit: the CI run is skipped, every job skipped, none on a runner (draft-probe-run.txt, draft-probe-jobs.txt)
Compare job counts before and after per event (job-counts.txt)
steps.result: A draft PR starts no CI jobs, a ready PR still runs all required checks, and a push to main runs 2 jobs instead of 8

verdicts.seen: Read 1 entry: status=completed conclusion=skipped event=pull_request for the draft probe PR 780 run. The draft part is shown. The ready-PR part is not in this capture, and the job-level detail is in capture_1.

Read 8 entries, each with runner=null and status skipped: check (24, app), relay-image, check (24, migrate), screens, changes, check (24, engine), package, done-done. This matches the draft part with all 8 skipped and none on a runner.

Read 8 entries, each showing success: changes, done-done, check (24, migrate), check (24, app), screens, check (24, engine), package, relay-image. This matches the ready-PR part with all 8 jobs passing.
